notes: Vehicles and car parts split: one is what you travel in, the other is what a car is made of.
'tools' dropped here — page 33 is fifty words of them.
Collisions kept together: bike/bicycle, taxi/cab, helicopter/chopper.

area.name: Vehicles
area.description: Cómo se mueve la gente: bicicletas y motos, carros y taxis, y los vehículos grandes que van por tierra o por aire.

units.name: Bikes and motorbikes
units.topic: Two-wheeled vehicles and the person who rides one. 'bike' and 'bicycle' are the same thing — bike is the everyday word

units.name: Cars and taxis
units.topic: Cars of different kinds and what you hire to be driven in. 'taxi' and 'cab' are the same thing

units.name: Big and flying
units.topic: Vehicles too large to park at a house, and the ones that leave the ground. 'chopper' is an informal word for a helicopter, and an 18-wheeler is the largest kind of truck
